notes: The MKR WiFi 1010 is not in the catalogue, so a new part type 'arduino-mkr-wifi-1010' was created with the pins shown in the wiring image.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: rows f-j on the image's upper half are bank 'b'. The image's row labels are read as: green wire in column 3 row g, resistor in row h from column 3 to column 6, LED legs in row i at columns 6 and 8, black wire in column 8 row h.
The LED's bent (longer) leg in column 6 is taken as the anode, connected through the resistor to pin 2. The straight leg in column 8 is the cathode, connected to GND. This matches the schematic.
The resistor is 220 Ω per the text and schematic.
The sketch also reads analog pin A1, but nothing is connected to it, so there is no edge for it.
The USB cable and computer used to upload and power the board are not shown in the diagrams, so they are not included.
